newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Adelaide Brighton to sell Hurricane stake.
newsitem.headline: Adelaide Brighton to sell Hurricane stake.

text.p: Building products group Adelaide Brighton Ltd said on Friday it haD agreed to sell its holding in Hurricane Wire Products Group for NZ$25 million to BTL Ltd.

Adelaide Brighton said the sale, due for settlement on August 15, would result in a A$2.0 million surplus over book value. Adelaide Brighton said BTL's major shareholder was Greenstone Fund Ltd, whose principal shareholders were National Mutual, AMP and the New Zealand National Provident Fund.
Adelaide Brighton said it understood BTL intended to develop and grow the Hurricane business, the last of Adelaide Brighton's New Zealand interests.
The sale was a further step in the strategy of focussing on the core businesses and debt reduction, it said.
Adelaide Brighton shares closed down four cents at A$1.90.
